name: Beam Pinch
description: Two beams of like charges moving along +x. Inside each beam Coulomb repulsion fights the magnetic attraction of parallel currents (Biot–Savart, ∝ v_i·v_j), which grows with speed: the slow beam (top, v = 0.5) spreads apart, while the fast one (bottom, v = 3) self-focuses into a pinched filament.

forces.name: Biot–Savart
forces.expression: k * q_i * q_j / r^3 * cross(v_i, cross(v_j, d))
